items.task: Fresh verifier for gate G2 of this track (checklist item C18; decision 0016 item 4). About ninety minutes, processors only, no card run. A full checksum pass of the stage check runs in the background since 2026-11-27 00:53 PST (log scratch/C-sidm/tmp/verify_full_g2.log): leave it alone, say in your report whether it has ended and with what result, and keep your own work to three cores while it runs. Trust nothing and do not read the lead's verdicts first (the outcome entries of the journals, stage/REVIEW-wave3.md, the verdict column of stage/G2/CHECKLIST.md): take what is claimed from stage/G2/RERUN.md, the list 'What the verifier should recompute first' of stage/G2/OPEN.md and Table VI of the note, the criteria from the track's scope text, the predictions as they were written before the runs (git log shows when). With readers of your own, each tested on an analytic case first, recompute from the registered outputs: (1) the equilibrium sequence and its turning point from a calculation of your own (the lead: y_max = 0.334032), and where the two members of the bracket (0.324, 0.344) lie on it; (2) the fates at a million particles: the member 0.344 collapses on both meshes and in both gauges and the member 0.324 holds 600 M (the lead's collapse times 252.31 M on M/8, 217.97 M on M/16, 252.41 M with the other shift damping, 229.79 M at a hundred thousand particles); every collapse time is the marker 'smallest lapse below 0.3', no run used the horizon finder: recompute the marker times from the histories and say what the marker can and cannot show (it is not a horizon); the stable members' central lapse within its band; (3) the controls without the kick: collapse at 295.78 M with ten thousand particles and at 534.81 M with a hundred thousand, none in 600 M with a million, and the constraint floors falling as 1/N: is 'the controls' collapses are particle noise' shown by these runs, or only consistent with them? (4) the collisional members: the collapse times on the three meshes (206.64, 163.41, 158.42 M) and with the other shift damping (164.01 M), the ratio of the measured collision rate to the expected one (1.0008) and the closure of the collision energy budget (3e-16) from the collision records, with an expected rate computed by you; the spread between collision seeds (2.24 M against the bar of 2 M: failed as written); (5) that the location of the threshold converges while the collapse time does not (13.6 per cent between the meshes): state what G2 can claim. A prediction before each recomputation, the outcome after it. Per claim: reproduced (to how many digits), not reproduced, or not checkable and why; predictions that failed as written are stated as failed (A.4, BA.3, NS.2, the seed-pair part of D2.3, the run D2eta1). Figures you look at. Write stage/G2/VERIFIER.md; only after it is written, a last section that compares with the lead's verdicts.
